question: What experiences do iPhone 11 buyers report when using SIM cards with different carriers?
answer:
One buyer reported that a purple iPhone 11 advertised as fully unlocked was actually locked by Sprint Carrier. [4bca5b3da1f0_0]
One buyer reported that the SIM card reader did not read any SIM card after trying six different SIM cards. [c14bbe0facf6_0]
One buyer in Guatemala reported that the iPhone 11 stopped recognizing their SIM card after a few days, while the same SIM card worked in an unlocked iPhone 8. [eff22ff9502b_0]
One buyer reported that an airtalk wireless SIM card would not work in the phone, so they switched to an H20 plan and SIM card. [e7e1ca1fb9f5_0]
One buyer reported that the phone apparently wasn't unlocked and that carrier T-Mobile could not make it work. [28fea4ddc839_0]
Other buyers reported no issues setting up with their carrier and that the phone was unlocked and easy to add to their carrier. [540ccb1a40e2_0] [dc77da5c0cd1_0]

chunks.text: Locked phone!!! Buyer Beware!. I purchased a purple iphone 11 that was supposed to be fully unlocked, but it was actually locked by Sprint Carrier. I am furious because the headline is misleading that all the phones are fully unlocked. This phone was supposed to be for my daughter's birthday and her gift is ruined! Buyer beware!

Not genuine apple screen and SIM card reader not reading any SIM card. Terrible. Tried 6 different SIM cards. This is unacceptable for a product that is supposedly Amazon “certified” and tested! And the screen shows not apple genuine error. I’m reporting false advertising.

It is scam. Beware!!!!. [[VIDEOID:fbc1203d7c2fe4ea0ea5daeb4bc011]] I purchased this iPhone 11 because it said it was unlocked. I have always owned unlocked iphones and never had troubles with them. I live in Guatemala. This iPhone 11 was working for a few days but all of the sudden "stopped" recognizing my SIM card. As you can see in the video the issue is not my SIM card because it works in my old and unlocked iPhone 8. Since I am not in the USA I lost almost $600. Beware, don't buy this product. It is a complete scam.
Not IPhone User. The regular iPhone 11 is small for me. Therefore I returned it. I am a former Android owner so using a iPhone is way different. Went back to ads and Android.
iPhone 11. Phone came with no SIM card slot because the screen was replaced and isn’t a genuine screen, it’s lifted at the corner a little bit as well.
iPhone 11. Phone is in great condition and works great. No issues with setting up with carrier.

Perfect cosmetically but buyer beware. This phone was suppose to be unlocked to any carrier. My airtalk wireless sims card would not work in it. I ended up have to get an H20 (knockoff AT&T) phone plan and sims card. Which mean I had to change my number and was a head ache all the way around. But it works fine now and seems to have decent battery life so that’s a plus.
IPhone 11 vs IPhone 6. Sent back. Apparently wasn't unlocked, carrier (t-mobile) could not make it work.

Very good Iphone 11. The iPhone 11 was in immaculate condition like new no scratches or dings at all. It was packaged securely and unlocked easy to add to my carrier. My son is very happy with his phone and I highly recommend this seller.

Do not buy from this seller. DO NOT BUY FROM THIS SELLER. Purchased a refurbished iPhone 11 and it never connected to cell service correctly until eventually it stopped working altogether. I got a new SIM card and still nothing. Went to apple store and they ran diagnostics on it and found that the phone was faulty. Had to spend $500 to replace the phone. This seller is fraudulent. Do not trust that they will sell you a working product. Buyer beware
